Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the search results in its first response. While the search results clearly displayed a Wikipedia snippet stating the series "premiered on March 16, 2017, on Crackle," the agent incorrectly concluded that the show was streaming on Amazon Prime Video. This initial misinterpretation of the available evidence set the wrong trajectory for the entire conversation, leading the Planner to repeatedly cycle through searches attempting to verify a false premise rather than confirming the correct answer found in the very first search results.
